title: Metalcore
tagline: Metal precision colliding with hardcore urgency.
summary: Metalcore combines heavy-metal riffing and breakdowns with the urgency and communal energy of hardcore punk. Early bands built a sound around abrupt rhythmic shifts, shouted vocals, and heavy guitar work; later waves incorporated melodic leads and polished production. The style continues to evolve across underground scenes and large festival stages.

pillars.name: Converge
pillars.why: Converge fused chaotic hardcore intensity with intricate, dissonant arrangements that became a key metalcore reference.

pillars.name: Killswitch Engage
pillars.why: Killswitch Engage helped bring melodic metalcore to a wider audience through harmonized guitar leads and strong hooks.

pillars.name: Integrity
pillars.why: Integrity's dark, aggressive blend of hardcore and metal helped shape the style's early underground sound.
